body.title: Add the identity module
body.summary: Add one module with ArtifactIds (make, parse, parentOf over every kind with the per-kind required and forbidden fields including AMD, TASKS and DIAG), RequirementIds (mint, parse returning { date, hash8, story?: number, fr } or undefined, isRequirementId, canonical and slug forms), InvalidArtifactKeyError, MissingAnchorError (a subclass) and the PathIntent type. id.ts is untouched. Unit tests pin its output to the text storage.ts and nextAmendmentId build today and to the stored requirement ids.
acceptanceChecks: make produces the stored text for every existing kind and parse returns an equal key
an uppercase story or task, a missing required field and a forbidden field (seq on TASKS, story on AMD) each throw InvalidArtifactKeyError
parse returns undefined for a folder name, a work-item id, an uppercase id and an old marker
stored requirement ids in the canonical and slug forms parse to date, hash8, story as a number and fr, and mint rejects an uppercase story
the new unit tests pass and the repository type-checks
